name: 画中人 · 人物传 VOL.7（陷阱猎人版）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP8《画中人》陷阱猎人版语法命门 12 题，按 R / SR / SSR 三档标注难度。本卷的画廊平面图、逻辑推理格（13–17）、传记阅读（18–20）、矛盾侦测与密码显影依赖纸面图与原文，未进题库。

m5.q: It is not easy ___ the truth in a room where everyone remembers a different yesterday.
m5.why: It 作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式 to find。

m5.q: This is ___ second time the sitter's hand has moved this week.
m5.why: 序数词前面用定冠词 the——the second time。

m5.q: Nobody could tell us ___ the change to the painting.
m5.why: 疑问词 + 不定式，作 tell 的宾语——how to explain。

m5.q: She looked out of the frame as if she ___ every one of our names.
m5.why: as if 引导与事实相反的情况，从句用过去式表虚拟。

m5.q: The news ___ the painting had changed spread through the school in one morning.
m5.why: 同位语从句说明 news 的内容，从句成分完整，用连词 that。

m5.q: Han copied twice ___ pages as Chen did that afternoon.
m5.why: twice as many + 可数名词复数 + as，pages 可数。

m5.q: ___ carefully Han copied, one line always came out different.
m5.why: no matter how + 副词，表示“无论多么仔细地”。

m5.q: ___ at the frame, Yu finally noticed that the hand had moved.
m5.why: 现在分词作状语，逻辑主语是 Yu，他是“看”的发出者。

m5.q: The rest of the notes ___ still on Han's desk, page after page.
m5.why: the rest of 的单复数跟着 of 后面的名词走，notes 是复数，用 are。

m5.q: By Friday morning Han ___ the same page for three days, and still it did not match.
m5.why: 过去完成进行时——到过去某一时刻为止一直在做，且还在继续。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: It was the cat that nobody had written down.
Having checked every page, Han said nothing.
Not until the third day she noticed the hand had moved.
The rest of the room was quiet.
m5.why: Not until 置于句首，主句要部分倒装 → Not until the third day did she notice…

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: She looked as if she had been waiting for years.
The record must changed by someone with the right to do it.
The hall is three times as wide as the room.
Nobody could tell us where to look next.
m5.why: 情态动词后面缺了 be——must have been changed 或 must be changed。
